patient_consents_staff_reason_check.name: patient_consents_staff_reason_check
patient_consents_staff_reason_check.value: ("clinical"."patient_consents"."recorded_by" is null) or ("clinical"."patient_consents"."reason" is not null and length(trim("clinical"."patient_consents"."reason")) > 0)

messages_address_check.name: messages_address_check
messages_address_check.value: ("clinical"."messages"."channel" <> 'email' and "clinical"."messages"."channel" <> 'sms') or ("clinical"."messages"."from_address" is not null and "clinical"."messages"."to_address" is not null)

tickets_verified_check.name: tickets_verified_check
tickets_verified_check.value:
("operational"."tickets"."patient_verified_at" is null) = ("operational"."tickets"."patient_verified_method" is null)
        and ("operational"."tickets"."patient_verified_at" is null or "operational"."tickets"."patient_id" is not null)
        and (("operational"."tickets"."patient_verified_by_user_id" is null) = ("operational"."tickets"."patient_verified_method" is null or "operational"."tickets"."patient_verified_method" = 'patient_app'))
